column1: Information Technology (IT) systems and controls in the consolidated financial statements (continued)

The calculations, recording and financial reporting of
transactions and balances recorded in the financial
statements is highly dependent on IT automated system
and processes. Gaps in the IT control environment could
result in the financial accounting and reporting records being
materially misstated.
Based on the above, we therefore determined IT systems
and controls to be a key audit matter.
